deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Left edge of hero gradient — anchors the purple sky of the landing banner

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Brand links, nav accents, heading highlights, logo wordmark — the only blue that carries brand meaning

spring-mint.$description: Spring Mint — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

hero-sky-blue.$description: Hero Sky Blue — Right edge of hero gradient — transitions from deep indigo to a cleaner blue, softening the landing page mood

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary body text and heading color — softer than pure black, keeps long-form copy comfortable

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Icon strokes, decorative illustration linework, highest-contrast text — used where maximum weight is needed

canvas-mist.$description: Canvas Mist — Page background — barely-blue tinted near-white, the calm base layer below the hero

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, nav background, content panels — sits one level above the mist canvas

steel-border.$description: Steel Border — Input borders, dividers, subtle structural lines — cool-toned to harmonize with the mist canvas

slate-caption.$description: Slate Caption — Muted helper text, secondary body copy, metadata — readable but recedes against charcoal

shadow-gray.$description: Shadow Gray — Soft elevation wash and button shadow base — used in the subtle 1px shadow stack

trustpilot-star.$description: Trustpilot Star — Review star fill on the Trustpilot social-proof line — the only yellow in the system, used exclusively for ratings

nista.$description: Sole typeface for the entire system — Nista's geometric warmth and bold-friendly weight stack carries everything from 10px metadata to 40px display headlines. The 800 weight on hero text gives authority without feeling heavy or corporate; the 400 body keeps long lesson descriptions breathable. Substitute: 'Poppins' or 'Nunito' for the friendly geometric quality, or 'DM Sans' for a cleaner alternative.
